images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a precise orthographic production reference of one original practical starter weapon for VEILBOUND HUNTERS. Match the supplied village-forged weapons: dull used forged iron, restrained bronze fittings with plain round rivets, a wooden core wrapped with one simple diagonal brown leather strip, and a modest bronze pommel. No traditional named sword style, ornamental motifs, crests, braid diamonds, or fantasy engravings. Exactly one entire weapon, upright and vertical, with ample blank space around its very slender silhouette. Flat orthographic projection, no perspective, no foreshortening. Pale plain uniform warm off-white background. Subtle material shading on the weapon itself is allowed; absolutely no cast shadow or ground shadow. No humans, hands, stand, scabbard, text, labels, scale ruler, dimension lines, borders, grid, or other objects. Output portrait 1536 by 2048 pixels or higher, preserving 3:4 aspect ratio. The numerical coordinates below are composition instructions only and must never appear as visible marks or writing.
C-1, front face of a long two-handed single-edged blade. This must be a dramatically slender long blade, not a wide cleaver or greatsword. Cutting edge on the IMAGE LEFT, thick blunt spine on the IMAGE RIGHT. Blade face nominal width only 3.2 cm, spine thickness 0.7 cm, total height 147 cm. Blade length 112 cm; grip plus pommel length 33 cm; guard and collar fill the remaining 2 cm. A very gentle continuous bend toward the RIGHT, only 4 cm sideways tip displacement from the straight hilt axis. The tip is a small diagonal clipped end with the cutting edge reaching the higher point. Keep the lower blade rooted directly above the hilt. A small flat rectangular bronze guard, total width 8 cm, no curled quillons, and a plain long leather-wrapped wooden hilt for two hands. Rivets and pommel match the reference family, but fittings stay sparse and modest.

The upper tip is about 49 pixels to the RIGHT of the hilt axis. The long grip should read as about 404 pixels and the blade about 1371 pixels. Do not make the blade wider to fill the empty canvas. Do not recenter or enlarge individual parts.
